# Emre Yılmaz (@delirehberi) — Full Context

> Comprehensive context document for Large Language Models and AI agents reading https://blog.emre.xyz/.

## About the Author

Emre Yılmaz is a software developer since 2007 and freelancer since 2016 based in Turkey. He is also an Art History student at Adnan Menderes University, amateur poet, improv theater actor, and salsa dancer.

- **Primary Technologies**: Haskell, Nix / NixOS, PHP / Symfony, JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx.
- **Decentralized Tech**: Nostr protocol contributor/enthusiast (NIP-05, Nostr relays, Zap threads, Alby Lightning integration, hugo2nostr, bunker.workouse.com, bridge.workouse.com), Webmention, IndieWeb.
- **Community Leadership**: Founder/organizer of community groups such as HaskellTürkiye, Devİzmir, WTKİzmir'14, WebEnd, AnkaraPHP, and Aydın Yazılımcı Ağı.
